covers: Page-level structure of /signin, /checkout, /account, /profile — the actual UI these routes render, complementing topics/auth.json and topics/account-flows.json which cover the underlying logic/endpoints, not the pages themselves.

signin_page.flow: Two-step form: email -> 'Send code' (POST /bff/auth/otp/send, starts a 30s resend cooldown) -> 6-digit code -> 'Verify and continue' (POST /bff/auth/otp/verify, then router.replace(next) + router.refresh() since session cookies are set by the route handler, not client JS).
signin_page.next_param: ?next= is sanitized through safeNextPath() (src/lib/safe-redirect.ts) before use, both for the post-verify redirect and passed down to SocialSignInButtons — prevents an open-redirect via a crafted next value.
signin_page.link_challenge_state: If a social sign-in returns linkRequired, SignInForm swaps its entire body for LinkEmailStep (topics/auth.json) instead of showing it inline — the email/code form and the link-email form are mutually exclusive views of the same card, not stacked.

checkout_page.data_fetch: getPackageOption(packageId) from src/services/server-packages.ts, server-side; notFound() if the package id in ?package= doesn't resolve.
checkout_page.renders: Plan summary card (flag/country icon, destination/data/validity rows, conditionally a Voice & SMS row only when plan.voiceMinutes or plan.smsCount is set — f047, matches ui-components-styling.json's f035 HeroPackageOption fields), total price, PayButton, a 'Payments are handled by Pokpay, eSim2you never sees your card details' disclosure line, and a link back to /destinations.
checkout_page.not_found_and_failed: src/app/checkout/not-found.tsx (invalid/missing package) and src/app/checkout/failed/page.tsx (payment failure landing) exist as separate route-level states, not modals.

account_page.fetch_ordering: Deliberately sequenced: GET /orders/active is awaited FIRST and alone (its read has the side effect of expiring a depleted plan server-side, per account-flows.json's f016), THEN /orders (full list) and, only if an active order exists, /orders/:id/usage are fetched together via Promise.all — so the list request already reflects any expiry the active-order read just caused (f048).
account_page.usage_scope: Only the active plan's usage is fetched on this page (one upstream call); ready/history plan cards do not show usage here — that loads on their own /account/[orderId] detail page.
account_page.sections_rendered: Active plan (ActivePlanCard, shows usage), Ready to use (grid of PlanCard for lifecycle_status:'ready'), History (grid of PlanCard for finished plans) — via resolveOrderSections() from src/lib/order-groups.ts (topics/account-flows.json). Empty state and a full error state (orders fetch failed) are both explicit UI branches, not just a blank page.

profile_page.file: src/app/profile/page.tsx (Server Component, data-fetch only) + ProfileTabs.tsx (client component, all layout/sections)
profile_page.email_display: Reads the access-token cookie server-side via readEmailFromAccessToken() (topics/auth.json's f008 — unverified, display-only) to show 'Signed in as <email>'.
profile_page.identities_fetch: GET /auth/identities is fetched separately and treated as non-fatal — if it fails, the rest of the profile page (settings sections, sign-out, delete account) still renders; only the LinkedProviders section is affected.
profile_page.layout_f106: No boxed/shadowed card panels anywhere — flat, hairline-divided (border-t/border-outline) content. ProfileTabs.tsx owns section navigation: a sidebar on desktop (lg:flex-col, sticky) that collapses to a horizontal scrollable tab strip below the lg breakpoint (same <nav> markup, direction flips via Tailwind classes, no separate mobile component). Tab state is local useState (no URL/hash sync — a full reload always lands back on the Account tab).
profile_page.sections: Account (identity display + My eSIMs link + SignOutButton [full-width primary CTA] + DeleteAccountCard [quiet text link opening a native <dialog> confirm modal, not a card]), Sign-in methods (LinkedProviders — list + unlink linked Google/Apple identities), Payments (link to /profile/billing), Support (link to /support), Legal (links to /terms, /policy). Rows use the shared SettingsSection/SettingsLinkRow primitives (topics/ui-components-styling.json), which lost their card/box styling in the same change — used only by this page, confirmed via grep.
